import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static long modinv(long a, long m) {
        assert m > 0;
        if (m == 1) return 0;
        a %= m;
        if (a < 0) a += m;
        assert a != 0;
        if (a == 1) return 1;
        return m - modinv(m, a) * m / a;
    }

    static class ModNum {
        int v;

        public static final int MOD = MOD;

        public ModNum() {
            this.v = 0;
        }

        public ModNum(long v_) {
            v = (int)(v_ % MOD);
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
        }

        public static ModNum operatorAdd(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            ModNum res = new ModNum();
            res.v = a.v + b.v;
            if (res.v >= MOD) res.v -= MOD;
            return res;
        }

        public static ModNum operatorSubtract(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            ModNum res = new ModNum();
            res.v = a.v - b.v;
            if (res.v < 0) res.v += MOD;
            return res;
        }

        public static ModNum operatorMultiply(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return new ModNum(((long)a.v * b.v) % MOD);
        }

        public static ModNum operatorDivide(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return a.multiply(~b);
        }

        public ModNum add(ModNum o) {
            this.v += o.v;
            if (this.v >= MOD) this.v -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public ModNum subtract(ModNum o) {
            this.v -= o.v;
            if (this.v < 0) this.v += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public ModNum multiply(ModNum o) {
            this.v = (int)(((long)this.v * o.v) % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        public ModNum divide(ModNum o) {
            return this.multiply(~o);
        }

        public static ModNum operatorPlus(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return a.add(b);
        }

        public static ModNum operatorMinus(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return a.subtract(b);
        }

        public static ModNum operatorTimes(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return a.multiply(b);
        }

        public static ModNum operatorDividedBy(ModNum a, ModNum b) {
            return a.divide(b);
        }

        public static ModNum operator~(ModNum a) {
            ModNum res = new ModNum();
            res.v = (int)modinv(a.v, MOD);
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = 6;
        ModNum[][] p = new ModNum[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = new ModNum(0);
            }
        }
        int _n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < _n; j++) {
                int a = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = new ModNum(a).divide(new ModNum(100));
            }
        }
        int f = 20;
        ModNum[] sets0 = new ModNum[1 << f];
        ModNum[] sets1 = new ModNum[1 << f];
        Arrays.fill(sets0, new ModNum(0));
        Arrays.fill(sets1, new ModNum(0));
        List<Integer> masks0 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> masks1 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                    masks0.add((1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k));
                    masks1.add(((1 << n) - 1) ^ masks0.get(masks0.size() - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        assert masks0.size() == f;
        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            for (int e = 0; e < (1 << (n / 2 * n)); e++) {
                ModNum prob = new ModNum(1);
                int[] edges = new int[n / 2];
                Arrays.fill(edges, 0);
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2 * n; i++) {
                    boolean r = ((e >> i) & 1) == 1;
                    ModNum pp = p[(i / n) * 2 + t][i % n];
                    prob = r ? prob.multiply(pp) : prob.multiply(new ModNum(1).subtract(pp));
                    edges[i / n] |= (r ? 1 : 0) << (i % n);
                }
                int work_mask = 0;
                for (int a = 0; a < masks0.size(); a++) {
                    int mask = masks0.get(a);
                    int[] r = new int[n / 2];
                    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                        r[i] = edges[i] & mask;
                    }
                    if (r[0] != 0 && r[1] != 0 && r[2] != 0) {
                        int total = 0;
                        for (int val : r) {
                            total += Integer.bitCount(val);
                        }
                        if (total == 3) {
                            int x = Integer.bitCount(r[0] | r[1]);
                            int y = Integer.bitCount(r[0] | r[2]);
                            int z = Integer.bitCount(r[1] | r[2]);
                            if (x >= 2 && y >= 2 && z >= 2) {
                                work_mask |= (1 << a);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                sets0[work_mask] = sets0[work_mask].add(prob);
            }
        }
        // Prefix sums for sets0
        for (int i = 0; i < f; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                    sets0[j ^ (1 << i)] = sets0[j ^ (1 << i)].add(sets0[j]);
                }
            }
        }
        ModNum ans = new ModNum(0);
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
            int complement = ((1 << f) - 1) ^ j;
            ans = ans.add(sets0[j].multiply(sets1[complement]));
        }
        ans = new ModNum(1).subtract(ans);
        System.out.println(ans.v);
    }
}
